tara: Heads-up 1: Hiring manager asked about an out-of-cycle band bump for a senior IC in APAC. They want it effective at FY start and are asking what evidence + approvals are needed. Any region-specific quirks?

devin: Quick checklist: manager evidence form, updated comp sheet (local currency + USD note), 2 artifacts, calibration notes. For APAC payroll be mindful of local payroll cutoff dates (varies by country). Also check local statutory rules for retro pay.

tara: Country is Singapore. Payroll cutoff there? And do we need finance sign-off for >10% changes?

devin: SG payroll cutoff is typically the 25th for the following month. If you miss it, earliest effective will be next month and backpay processed as a lump sum. Finance sign-off: any comp change >15% or hires/transfers with tax implications require finance review. 10-15% can be routed to comp reviewer.

ash: Approvals flow: manager -> skip-level -> People Ops reviewer -> comp committee (only if band change across levels or >15%). Note: include peer calibration notes referencing our leveling rubric sections.

marta: For evidence, managers should map specific examples to rubric buckets (scope, autonomy, impact). Please include dates and links to artifacts (PRs, OKR metric exports, customer comms). Saves back-and-forth.

tara: If the manager wants effective date = FY start but payroll cutoff missed, is it standard to approve now and apply backpay? Any tax/reporting risks?

devin: Standard practice: approve now so HR records reflect new comp; payroll will calculate backpay in the next available run. For Singapore, payroll handles lumpsum; tax is applied in the lump sum year which could affect employee withholding. Finance runs the tax-impact check for large retroactive amounts. Mention the retro date and reason in the evidence form.

peopleops-bot: [automated] Evidence form received. Reference ID: MEF-2026-1755002468. People Ops will acknowledge within 2 business days.

tara: Anything else for manager to avoid delays?

marta: Use this short template in the form comments:
- One-line change (title/band/target comp)
- Why now (business reason + impact metrics)
- 3 examples tied to rubric (link each)
- Peers/benchmarks used in calibration
- Requested effective date + any special payroll notes

marta: Also flag if international transfer, mobility/legal must sign off before submission.

tara: Thanks 1! I'll nudge the manager to submit today and attach the artifacts.

ash: If you want, I can pre-check the comp sheet before routing. :+1:

tara: That would be great, thanks all.
